label: prf:categorical-jet-prolongation
title: Proof of categorical jet prolongation
html: The splitting j^1 \circ \ell = \mathrm{id}_A is the jet object splitting. For the second statement, suppose a multiplicative comultiplication \Delta on J^1(k[X]) restricts along both jet sections to the additive coproduct \Delta X = X \otimes 1 + 1 \otimes X. Then the difference of the two images of X, the class dX = [X \otimes 1 - 1 \otimes X], is a primitive element whose square is zero, and in characteristic zero such an element lies in I^2. But dX \notin I^2: the derivative d/dX induces a functional on k[X] \otimes k[X] that vanishes on I^2 and takes the value 1 on X \otimes 1 - 1 \otimes X, a contradiction. \square
